mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants price in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY) trigger Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% MoM signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate systemic supply-side economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as output contraction impacts corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth < 0.0% MoM, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
